Apart from the theme, keep it recognizably the same: same faces, features, hair and distinctive details, and do not add anyone or anything else that is not in the reference. Ignore the background and whatever is underneath the subject. Whole subject alone, centered and large, with a clear white margin on every side so that nothing touches the edge of the image, standing on a small plain round base in the figure's dark color, isolated on a plain white background with a soft contact shadow.
